function(edgefast_open_add_subdirectory dir)
    # Convert to absolute path
    set(abs_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${dir}")
    mcux_add_cmakelists(${abs_dir} OPTIONAL)
endfunction()

function(edgefast_open_add_subdirectory_ifdef config_option dir)
    if(${config_option})
        # Convert to absolute path
        set(abs_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${dir}")
        mcux_add_cmakelists(${abs_dir} OPTIONAL)
    endif()
endfunction()

function(zephyr_library_sources)
    set(sources_list "")
    set(toolchains_list "")
    set(parsing_toolchains FALSE)

    foreach(arg ${ARGV})
        if(arg STREQUAL "TOOLCHAINS")
            set(parsing_toolchains TRUE)
        elseif(parsing_toolchains)
            list(APPEND toolchains_list ${arg})
        else()
            list(APPEND sources_list ${arg})
        endif()
    endforeach()

    foreach(source_file ${sources_list})
        if(toolchains_list)
            mcux_add_source(
                SOURCES ${source_file}
                TOOLCHAINS ${toolchains_list}
            )
        else()
            mcux_add_source(
                SOURCES ${source_file}
            )
        endif()
    endforeach()
endfunction()

function(zephyr_library_sources_ifdef config_option)
    if(${config_option})
        set(sources_list "")
        set(toolchains_list "")
        set(parsing_toolchains FALSE)

        foreach(arg ${ARGN})
            if(arg STREQUAL "TOOLCHAINS")
                set(parsing_toolchains TRUE)
            elseif(parsing_toolchains)
                list(APPEND toolchains_list ${arg})
            else()
                list(APPEND sources_list ${arg})
            endif()
        endforeach()

        foreach(source_file ${sources_list})
            if(toolchains_list)
                mcux_add_source(
                    SOURCES ${source_file}
                    TOOLCHAINS ${toolchains_list}
                )
            else()
                mcux_add_source(
                    SOURCES ${source_file}
                )
            endif()
        endforeach()
    endif()
endfunction()

function(zephyr_sources_ifdef)
    zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(${ARGV})
endfunction()

function(zephyr_sources)
    zephyr_library_sources(${ARGV})
endfunction()

function(zephyr_include_directories)
    set(includes_list "")
    set(toolchains_list "")
    set(parsing_toolchains FALSE)

    foreach(arg ${ARGV})
        if(arg STREQUAL "TOOLCHAINS")
            set(parsing_toolchains TRUE)
        elseif(parsing_toolchains)
            list(APPEND toolchains_list ${arg})
        else()
            list(APPEND includes_list ${arg})
        endif()
    endforeach()

    foreach(include_path ${includes_list})
        if(toolchains_list)
            mcux_add_include(
                INCLUDES ${include_path}
                TOOLCHAINS ${toolchains_list}
            )
        else()
            mcux_add_include(
                INCLUDES ${include_path}
            )
        endif()
    endforeach()
endfunction()

function(zephyr_include_directories_ifdef config_option)
    if(${config_option})
        set(includes_list "")
        set(toolchains_list "")
        set(parsing_toolchains FALSE)

        foreach(arg ${ARGN})
            if(arg STREQUAL "TOOLCHAINS")

            elseif(parsing_toolchains)

            else()
                list(APPEND includes_list ${arg})

        endforeach()

        foreach(include_path ${includes_list})
            if(toolchains_list)
                mcux_add_include(
                    INCLUDES ${include_path}
                    TOOLCHAINS ${toolchains_list}
                )
            else()
                mcux_add_include(
                    INCLUDES ${include_path}
                )
            endif()
        endforeach()
    endif()
endfunction()

if(CONFIG_MCUX_COMPONENT_middleware.edgefast_open.edgefast_open_suppressed_warnings)
	# For liblc3
	mcux_add_iar_configuration(
		CC "--diag_suppress=Pa093,Pa092"
	)

	# Error[Pa039]: use of address of unaligned structure member
	# sys_put_be16(seq_num, (uint8_t *)&media_hdr->sequence_number);
	mcux_add_iar_configuration(
		CC "--diag_suppress=Pa039"
	)

	mcux_add_iar_configuration(
		CC "--diag_suppress=Pa134"
	)

	# use of a const variable in a constant expression is nonstandard in C
	mcux_add_iar_configuration(
		CC "--diag_suppress=Pe1901"
	)

	mcux_add_armgcc_configuration(
		CC "-Wno-format-zero-length -Wno-pointer-sign -Wno-unused-but-set-variable -Wno-format"
		CX "-Wno-format-zero-length -Wno-pointer-sign -Wno-unused-but-set-variable -Wno-format"
	)

	#struct bt_hfp_hf *hf = CONTAINER_OF(hf_at, struct bt_hfp_hf, at);
	#LOG_DBG("CMEE set (result %d) on %p", result, hf);
	#The code has no warning because the LOG sys in zephyr can use the variable.
	mcux_add_armgcc_configuration(
		CC "-Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function"
		CX "-Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function"
	)

	# tbs.c:650:70: error: array subscript has type 'char' [-Werror=char-subscripts]
	mcux_add_armgcc_configuration(
		CC "-Wno-char-subscripts"
		CX "-Wno-char-subscripts"
	)

	mcux_add_mdk_configuration(
		CC "-Wno-format-zero-length -Wno-pointer-sign -Wno-unused-but-set-variable -Wno-format"
		CX "-Wno-format-zero-length -Wno-pointer-sign -Wno-unused-but-set-variable -Wno-format"
	)

	mcux_add_mdk_configuration(
		CC "-Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function"
		CX "-Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function"
	)

	mcux_add_mdk_configuration(
		CC "-Wno-char-subscripts"
		CX "-Wno-char-subscripts"
	)

	#att_internal.h:345:16 typedef void (*bt_gatt_complete_func_t) (struct bt_conn *conn, void *user_data);
	mcux_add_mdk_configuration(
		CC "-Wno-typedef-redefinition"
		CX "-Wno-typedef-redefinition"
	)

	# tester/src/btp_hfp_ag.c:1689:19: result of comparison of constant 256 with expression of
	# type 'const uint8_t' (aka 'const unsigned char') is always false
	# if (cp->text_len >= sizeof(text)) {
	mcux_add_mdk_configuration(
		CC "-Wno-tautological-constant-out-of-range-compare"
		CX "-Wno-tautological-constant-out-of-range-compare"
	)
endif()

mcux_add_iar_configuration(
    CC "--diag_suppress=Ta184"  # Using zero sized arrays except for as last
                                # member of a struct is discouraged and
                                # dereferencing elements in such an array has
                                # undefined behavior
    CX "--diag_suppress=Ta184"  # Using zero sized arrays except for as last
                                # member of a struct is discouraged and
                                # dereferencing elements in such an array has
                                # undefined behavior
)

mcux_add_iar_configuration(
    CC "--vla"
    CX "--vla"
)

mcux_add_iar_configuration(
    CC "--diag_suppress=Pe1717"  # array of elements containing a flexible
                                 # array member is nonstandard
    CX "--diag_suppress=Pe1717"  # array of elements containing a flexible
                                 # array member is nonstandard
)

if(CONFIG_MCUX_COMPONENT_middleware.edgefast_open.suppressed_warnings)
    # Pe223: function "xxx" declared implicitly
    # Pe054: too few arguments in invocation of macro
    # Pe1675: unrecognized GCC pragma
    # Pe111: statement is unreachable
    # Pe1143: arithmetic on pointer to void or function type
    # Pe068: integer conversion resulted in a change of sign
    mcux_add_iar_configuration(
        CC "--diag_suppress=Pe068,Pe1143,Pe111,Pe1675,Pe054,Pe223"
        CX "--diag_suppress=Pe068,Pe1143,Pe111,Pe1675,Pe054,Pe223"
    )

    # Dedicated suppression for Pa217 (label is defined but never used).
    # TODO(upstream): Remove this once the root cause is fixed upstream.
    # Rationale: Keeping this separate avoids unintentionally masking new Pa217
    # warnings introduced by Edgefast Open.
    mcux_add_iar_configuration(
        CC "--diag_suppress=Pa217"
        CX "--diag_suppress=Pa217"
    )

    if(NOT W MATCHES "3")
        # Pe381: extra ";" ignored
        mcux_add_iar_configuration(
            CC "--diag_suppress=Pe381"
            CX "--diag_suppress=Pe381"
        )
    endif()

    if(NOT W MATCHES "2" AND NOT W MATCHES "3")
        # Pe1097: unknown attribute
        # Pa082: undefined behavior: the order of volatile accesses is undefined
        # Pa084: pointless integer comparison, the result is always false
        # Pe185: dynamic initialization in unreachable code
        # Pe167: argument of type "onoff_notify_fn" is incompatible with...
        # Pe144: a value of type "void *" cannot be used to initialize...
        # Pe177: function "xxx" was declared but never referenced
        # Pe513: a value of type "void *" cannot be assigned to an
        #        entity of type "int (*)(int)"
        mcux_add_iar_configuration(
            CC "--diag_suppress=Pe513,Pe177,Pe144,Pe167,Pe185,Pa084,Pa082,Pe1097"
            CX "--diag_suppress=Pe513,Pe177,Pe144,Pe167,Pe185,Pa084,Pa082,Pe1097"
        )
    endif()

    if(NOT W MATCHES "1" AND NOT W MATCHES "2" AND NOT W MATCHES "3")
        # Pe188: enumerated type mixed with another type
        # Pe128: loop is not reachable
        # Pe550: variable "res" was set but never used
        # Pe546: transfer of control bypasses initialization
        # Pe186: pointless comparison of unsigned integer with zero
        # Pe054: too few arguments in invocation of macro xxx
        # Pe144: a value of type "void *" cannot be used to initialize an
        #        entity of type [...] "void (*)(struct onoff_manager *, int)"
        # Pe167: argument of type "void *" is incompatible with [...]
        #        "void (*)(void *, void *, void *)"
        mcux_add_iar_configuration(
            CC "--diag_suppress=Pe054,Pe186,Pe546,Pe550,Pe128,Pe188,Pe144,Pe167"
            CX "--diag_suppress=Pe054,Pe186,Pe546,Pe550,Pe128,Pe188,Pe144,Pe167"
        )
    endif()
endif()

mcux_add_source(
    TOOLCHAINS iar
    BASE_PATH ${SdkRootDirPath}
    SOURCES middleware/edgefast_open/include/zephyr/toolchain/iar/iar_missing_defs.h
    PREINCLUDE True
    PREINCLUDE_TYPE c_include cpp_include
)
endif()
